lines.text: Joshua orders large stones rolled against the mouth of the cave at Makkedah where the five kings hid.
Joshua has the five kings brought out and tells his commanders to put their feet on their necks.
Caleb strikes down the five kings and hangs them on five trees until sunset.
Joshua moves from Makkedah to Libnah, Lachish, Eglon, Hebron and Debir, capturing each city and leaving no survivors.
Joshua conquers from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza in one campaign because the LORD fought for Israel, then returns to Shiloh.
